title: Apps Compose, Framework Owns UI
description: Enforce that apps never define UI themselves — they only compose features and framework/ui-provided UI elements. A 50-agent audit found ~15 apps re-implementing UI primitives, hand-authoring HTML shells, duplicating icon/entity registries, and using a `component:` escape hatch to smuggle bespoke React into declarative window definitions. Build the missing framework mechanisms (status-surface kit, viewer vocabulary, entity catalog, desktop chrome contract, form kit, host bootstrap, drop-zone, router link, recovery panel, .NET palette bridge), migrate every violating app onto them, and add permanent lint enforcement (extending existing check-no-px/check-no-raw-colors/plugin-capability scanners) so the pattern cannot regress. Full plan: /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/all-apps-must-not-staged-storm.md
